name: Mission Hill Oculus 2017
text:
## Mission Hill Oculus 2017

**The story.** Mission Hill Family Estate sits atop Mission Hill in [West Kelowna](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Mission+Hill+Family+Estate,+West+Kelowna,+British+Columbia,+Canada&t=k), overlooking [Okanagan Lake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Okanagan_Lake). The winery was founded in 1966. In the 1970s Anthony von Mandl, then a Vancouver wine seller, helped with a feasibility study for a Mosel winery thinking of planting in the Okanagan; the Germans passed, but von Mandl was convinced, and in 1981 he bought the abandoned Mission Hill estate. (He also founded Mike's Hard Lemonade.) The breakthrough came when the 1992 Chardonnay won "Best Chardonnay" at the 1994 [International Wine and Spirit Competition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Wine_and_Spirit_Competition), the first overseas recognition for an Okanagan winery ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mission_Hill_Family_Estate)).

**The buildings.** In 1996 the estate commissioned [Olson Kundig](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olson_Kundig) to rebuild it, the firm's first winery. The work took until 2002 and cost an estimated 35 million Canadian dollars. Its focal point is a twelve-storey bell tower with four bells cast by the Paccard foundry in Annecy, which also made bells for St. Patrick's Cathedral in New York and the Sacré-Cœur in Paris ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mission_Hill_Family_Estate)).

**The wine: Oculus.** Oculus is the flagship of the Legacy Collection. An [oculus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oculus_%28architecture%29) is the round opening the Romans used in buildings such as the [Pantheon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pantheon,_Rome); at Mission Hill, the oculus gives the only natural light to the underground barrel cellar, which was blasted out of volcanic rock ([Mission Hill, 2017 Oculus tech sheet](https://www.missionhillwinery.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Legacy_Oculus_2017.pdf)). The 2017 is 49% [Merlot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Merlot), 26% [Cabernet Sauvignon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cabernet_Sauvignon) and 25% [Cabernet Franc](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cabernet_Franc), 99% from the Osoyoos estate in the far south of the [Okanagan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Okanagan_Valley_%28wine_region%29). It was fermented in small French oak fermenters, with a little in concrete, then aged 18 months in barriques, 25% new; 14.5% alcohol ([Mission Hill](https://www.missionhillwinery.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Legacy_Oculus_2017.pdf)).

**The vintage.** Mission Hill describes 2017 as a year of extremes: a cool, wet spring and a late start, then a record-breaking dry spell through July and August with temperatures well above normal. The result was small, concentrated berries, and a 66-day harvest that ended on 30 October with a crop "reminiscent of the incredible 2009 vintage" ([Mission Hill](https://www.missionhillwinery.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Legacy_Oculus_2017.pdf)).

**What the critics say for 2017.**
- **Anthony Gismondi, Gismondi on Wine: 93** (September 2020, [review](https://gismondionwine.com/tasting-notes/202009/mission-hill-family-estate-oculus-2017)). "One of the biggest young versions of wine I have tasted, possibly rivalling 2009": rich and full-bodied, awash in savoury black fruit, with substantial, fine-textured tannins. Winemaker Darryl Brooker had cut the new oak to about 25% and raised the Cabernet Franc to 25%, "and both moves seem to suit the flagship". "Can we say more California, less Europe this year? It will require a decade of watching before seeing the whole story."
- **[CellarTracker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CellarTracker) community: 90.0** (from your CellarTracker list).

**How it's drinking now.** In October 2026 the wine is nine years old. Your CellarTracker list gives a window of 2023 to 2032, and the estate says it is at its best until 2032. So it is just coming into its own. Decant it one to two hours ahead and serve at 16 to 18°C.

**Food.** Rack of lamb, a grilled beef tenderloin, or venison with a blackberry sauce.

**Value and where to buy.** Later vintages are easy to find: BC Liquor has the Oculus 2018 at $185.99 and the 2019 and 2020 at $225.99, ZYN has the 2020 at $252, and BSW Liquor has the 2020 at $280. BC Liquor also lists older large formats: the 2014 in a 1.5 L magnum at $405.99 and a 3 L at $975.

**Curious details**
- **A restaurant with a view.** The estate's Terrace restaurant, opened in 2002, was named by Travel + Leisure in 2008 as one of the five best winery restaurants in the world ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mission_Hill_Family_Estate)).
- **Okanagan's first vines** were planted by an Oblate missionary, Father Charles Pandosy, in 1859, to make sacramental wine ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Okanagan_Valley_%28wine_region%29)).
